articleTitle: A High Speed Convergent Formula for Time-Variant Generalized Sylvester Equation Solving
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The construction of novel and faster categories of recurrent neural networks (RNN) is an important and interesting field of study in domains, which are related with engineering and applied mathematics problems. Different nonlinear odd and increasing functions called activation functions (AFs) have been used for the acceleration of the convergence speed of each RNN formula. In the context of this research a faster model based on a novel AF will be constructed and applied for time-varying generalized Sylvester equation (TVGSE) solving, while theoretical convergence analysis and simulation experiment in MATLAB’s environment, will show the effectiveness of the proposed formula.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Digital Twin Implementation for Mechatronic System Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Digital Twin is a driving technology for Industry 4.0 that enables novel capabilities like smart process control, fault detection, or remaining useful life estimation. Since a Digital Twin is an up-to-date representation of an actual physical process, building this model requires exchanging many datasets from the physical assets. Usually, it is performed on external servers within a cloud-computig architecture that communicates physical assets with the digital twin model. However, the cloud exchange introduces transmission delays and security and data privacy issues that hamper digital asset updates and create safety concerns. Hence, we propose an FPGA-based digital twin implementation where the datasets are taken directly from the physical asset running parallel to the digital asset. This setup eliminates the need for big data and cloud upload, ensuring data privacy and faster, efficient digital twin implementation and update. A case study is implemented to demonstrate embedded Digital Twin capabilities for monitoring mechatronic systems under fault events.

articleTitle: Rolling force prediction of hot-rolled transverse thickness-varying plates based on stochastic configuration network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Rolling force determines the quality and production stability of hot-rolled products, so it is important to be predicted accurately. Nowadays, rolling force prediction is mostly focused on flat rolls, and there are few reports on rolling force prediction for transverse variable thickness steel plates during MAS rolling. In this paper, a SCN-based prediction model for the rolling force of transverse variable thickness plates is proposed, and the prediction model is established with variable thickness parameters, rolling process parameters, and material composition as inputs. The model was tested using actual industrial data, and the results show that the SCN-based rolling force prediction model has the highest prediction accuracy and stability in the paper, with MAE and MAPE of 810.18kN and 2.46%, respectively. The model also has the advantages of simple modeling and less manual adjustment of parameters, which has great potential for application in the field of hot rolling.

articleTitle: Design and dynamics control of a lightweight 6-axis collaborative robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The 6-axis robots are highly flexible and controllable, making them essential to the manufacturing industry. With the right motion planning, robots may do a variety of challenging jobs. However, due to their complex, nonlinear nature, controlling robots is influenced by several factors. Achieving high precision and intelligent, networked operation requires a comprehensive understanding of robot control. This paper presents an approach for designing and controlling a lightweight 6-axis collaborative robot. Firstly, a novel design method is proposed and implemented to fabricate the robot. Secondly, we identified the kinetic parameters and joint friction of the fabricated robot to obtain a better understanding of its motion dynamics. Lastly, we developed a kinetic control strategy based on the identified parameters and friction, which enables the robot to perform precise movements even in complex environments.

articleTitle: DMD-T: Thermographic Inspection of Composites using Dynamic Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In the realm of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) of fibre reinforced polymers, InfraRed Thermography (IRT) serves as a valuable tool for diagnosis. Various processing techniques, such as principal component analysis, Fourier transformation, and thermographic signal reconstruction, are commonly utilized to improve the identification of defects. However, the practical application of infrared thermography is limited by the need for expert operator experience, which hampers its broader adoption in industrial settings. This paper presents a preliminary examination of the application of data-driven based Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to study the thermal dynamics of composites and evaluate its potential for defect detection. The new method is known as the DMD for Thermography (DMD-T). The performance has been validated via an experimental dataset of a Carbon Fibre Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) plate with an impact damage.

articleTitle: A Review of Research of Digital Twin Technology for CNC Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: As manufacturing systems developed in the direction of digitization, networking and intelligence, digital twin technology has been developed so as to enhance communication between real machining and simulation. CNC machine tools equiped with digital twin technology can be seen as a kind of CNC machine tools in a virtual environment with digitalization and networking as the core, and is an important way to realize the intelligence and automation of CNC machine tools. The development of research on digital twin technology in CNC machining is reviewed in this paper, and the future development trend is prospected by combining the current research hotspots. The whole content can be divided into the following parts. First, the basic concept of digital twin CNC machine tools is introduced. Then, the related research at home and abroad is explained and analyzed from the aspects of error prediction, parameter optimization, real-time monitoring and troubleshooting, etc. Finally, the current problems are pointed out and future development trends and research directions are proposed, which provide some references to promote the realm of future manufacturing and also play a pivotal role in the exploration and implementation of digital twin technology.

articleTitle: Resilient Distributed Algorithms for Exponential Nash Equilibrium Seeking
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper studies a resilient distributed Nash equilibrium (NE) seeking problem on a directed communication network subject to Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks, The existence of cyber-attacks may result in undesirable performance degradations or even the failures of distributed algorithm to seek the NE of noncooperative games. In contrast to existing distributed NE seeking results over a prefect communication network, an attack-resilient distributed NE seeking framework was developed from a hybrid perspective. The proposed attack-resilient distributed algorithm guarantees that the NE can be exactly reached with an exponential convergence rate under the DoS attacks. An explicit analysis of the attack frequency and duration is investigated to enable exponential NE seeking with resilience against attacks. Examples and numerical simulation results are given to show the effectiveness of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Wheeled Mobile Robot Based on Model Predictive Control without Terminal Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Model Predictive Control(MPC) without terminal constraints can make the controller have higher dynamic performance and less computation. However, how to design a MPC algorithm without terminal constraints for a specific system while ensuring the stability of the system has become a challenging research. In this paper, a feasible form of MPC without terminal constraints is given for nonlinear systems by constructing cost functions and Lyapunov functions. We show that for MPC algorithms without terminal constraints, there is control input to stabilize the system. Then we propose a new trajectory tracking error model based on non-linear the wheeled mobile robot(WMR) system and design a MPC algorithm without terminal constraints under the framework of the model. Finally, the simulation results show that the algorithm can also guarantee the gradual convergence of WMR error tracking system to the origin without terminal constraints.

articleTitle: Color Image Encryption Based on 4D Hyperchaotic System and RSA Algorithm Combined Scrambling and Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In this paper, a color image encryption scheme based on 4D hyperchaos system and RSA algorithm is proposed. Firstly, RSA algorithm is used to generate the initial value of 4D hyperchaotic system, and the key stream is iteratively generated. Then, the color image is divided into RGB three channels. In order to change the position of image pixels, Arnold scrambling is performed on the image. Finally, simultaneous scrambling and diffusion algorithms are used to encrypt the preprocessed images for a second time. Experimental results show that the encryption scheme proposed in this paper is effective. Compared with the existing algorithms, this encryption scheme improves the encryption efficiency, has strong anti-aggression and robustness.

articleTitle: Robust Stochastic Configuration Network Based Prediction Model of Total Nitrogen Content in Crude Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The refineries usually process the blending crude oil at present. Blending crude oil leads to the increased uncertainties of physical properties of crude oil. This paper presents a robust stochastic configuration network (SCN) based prediction model for total nitrogen content in crude oil. First, the robust SCN based on Bayesian framework is proposed. In the Bayesian framework, the noise and outliers are assumed to be the mixture of two Gaussian distributions to improve the robustness of SCN. Then, to solve the problem that there are no analytical solutions of parameters due to the assumption of mixture of Gaussian distributions, parameters of the proposed robust SCN are estimated by the expectation maximization (EM) algorithm. Experiments using the real-world data collected from a refinery are carried out. The results indicate that the proposed approach has better accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Control of Multi-Input Multi-Output Nonlinear Systems With Output Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the prescribed performance control problem for the multiple-input and multiple-output nonlinear systems subject to output constraints. We focus on the case where the references are unknown beforehand and the output constraints are asymmetric and time-varying, which render the traditional PPC approaches infeasible. To conquer these challenges, a novel robust prescribed performance control approach is put forward in this paper. A special transformation function is introduced to online generate asymmetric time-varying error boundaries. Further, a coordinate transformation is cleverly introduced to deal with asymmetric bounds. By using the Barrier functions, both the prescribed tracking accuracy and the output constraints are guaranteed. And all the closed-loop signals are bounded. The simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Prediction of Furnace Temperature of Municipal Solid Waste Incinerator Based on SSA-ELMAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Municipal solid waste incineration (municipal solid wastes incineration, MSWI) is a common method to reduce waste and produce energy. In the process of municipal solid waste incineration, furnace temperature is an important index to control and optimize the process of municipal solid waste incineration. However, due to the limitation of environment and instruments, it is difficult to accurately measure the furnace temperature online. This paper proposes a neural network based on Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) to optimize Elman, and designs a furnace temperature prediction model for urban solid waste incineration process, trying to obtain real-time and accurate measurement of furnace temperature. The structure and training method of the prediction model based on SSA-ELMAN network are introduced in detail, and the nonlinear relationship between furnace temperature and other process variables is established. Finally, a comparative experiment was carried out using the historical data of a waste incineration plant. The results show that the furnace temperature model established in this paper has the advantages of accuracy, generalization ability, stability and training efficiency.

articleTitle: CO Emission Prediction of MSWI Processes Based on Nonlinear Feature Reduction Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Carbon monoxide (CO), one of the by-products of the municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) processes, is a toxic gas that is harm to human health. Moreover, its emission concentration relates to the dioxins (DXN) from the MSWI plant directly. Thus, the CO emission concentration should be predicted in terms of assisting the optimal control of pollutant emission in the MSWI process. In this article, a prediction method of CO emission concentration based on nonlinear feature reduction and long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) is proposed. Firstly, the nonlinear feature selection based on mutual information (MI) is carried out on the preprocessed data to remove the features with weak correlation. Then, the nonlinear features were extracted based on one-dimensional convolution (1DCNN), which is fed into LSTM to construct the prediction model. The convolutional layer and LSTM parameters are updated based on the loss function. Finally, the validity and rationality of the proposed method are verified based on the benchmark dataset and the actual industrial CO dataset.

articleTitle: Flame Combustion State Identification Based on CNN in Municipal Solid Waste Incineration Process
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Municipal solid waste (MSW) has characteristics such as large component differences and unstable calorific value. Flame combustion automatic state identification is beneficial for achieving stable control of the MSW incineration (MSWI) process in terms of feedback control. The industrial site usually recognizes the combustion state based on the visual perception mechanism of domain experts' experience. Based on the widely application of convolutional neural network (CNN) in the field of image recognition, this article chooses Lenet-5 as the recognition model of flame combustion state recognition. In order to obtain an appropriate CNN model to automatically extract flame image features, the influence of multiple CNN networks on flame image feature is designed and tested. The optimal structure setting of the CNN network is obtained. This study can provide support for practical applications in industrial sites.

articleTitle: Understanding Money Distribution in Closed Economic Systems: A Graph Theoretical Approach with Quantum Random Walks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In this article, we explore money distribution in closed economic systems, where the number of economic agents is constant and the total amount of money is conserved. We simulate these systems through graph theory, representing economic agents as vertices connected by edges that signify possible transactions. In our model, these transactions follow a quantum random walk. We apply different attributes of the graph, such as vertex connectivity, vertex degree, and global clustering coefficient, to understand their impact on the Gini coefficient, a measure of wealth inequality.

articleTitle: Towards Efficient Adaptive Regulation of Adjustable Load Groups: A Prototype System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: With the swift progress of demand response, distributed power generation, load-side control technology, and the self-regulation of individual power devices facilitated by smart grids, the control and optimization of power grids in the future will encounter an extensive array of control units. In this study, a prototype system is introduced for a cooperative adaptive regulation device designed for adjustable load groups. This system facilitates rapid removal and access to large-scale heterogeneous small-capacity decentralized adjustable loads while exhibiting a high level of adaptability. Ultimately, simulation experiments demonstrate that the system can fulfill the anticipated specification requirements.

articleTitle: Acoustic Localization Based on the D-S Evidence Theory for Pressurized Gas Leakage Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The sound source localization of ultrasonic signals generated by pressurized gas leakage was studied. The TDOA based sound source localization algorithm is always used to locate the leakage source. Since the sensors used to locate the sound source are often far from the sound source, and often only far-field models can be applied to estimate the direction of the sound source relative to the sensors. To determine the location of the sound source, it is necessary to take acoustic measurements at different positions around the sound source, such as by using a mobile robot, and fuse the measurement data. In addition, the estimated directions of the sound source usually contain uncertainties due to the noise during the measurements. To localize the sound source precisely and reliably, the D-S evidence theory was carried out in our research, in which an acoustic mass function was constructed to calculate a spatial distribution of the leakage source’s location. The proposed method was verified with experiments in which the sound source was simulated with an ultrasonic transmitter, and a linearly and equidistantly distributed microphone linear array was used to estimate the direction where the ultrasonic wave came from. The experimental results show that the proposed method can be used to localize the sound source and has good accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: An Incentive Mechanism for Manufacturing Industry Chain Members to Share Data
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In the manufacturing industry chain, the production of products involves many enterprises and generates large-scale traceability data. In order to encourage enterprises to actively sharing data, the paper designs an incentive mechanism. In this paper, we first establish an evolutionary game model of enterprise data sharing incentives, and then simulate several different evolutionary paths using simulation. The incentive value given by the blockchain platform is reasonable when all enterprises participate in data sharing.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Sliding Mode Control of High-speed Train Based on Fuzzy Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In order to meet the operational requirements of the high-speed train in terms of safety, accuracy and smoothness, an adaptive backstepping sliding mode control approach based on fuzzy regulation is put forward in this paper. Firstly, to solve the problem of insufficient accuracy of the single point model, this paper establishes a mass point dynamics model of the high-speed train and sets a compensation term for the model considering the uncertainties in the operation process. Secondly, the adaptive law is designed to estimate the compensation term and the new backstepping sliding mode control strategy is developed. Finally, fuzzy rules are designed to adjust the switching gain of the sliding mode term to suppress jitter. The results of simulation and comparison experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed modeling and control method.

articleTitle: The Stratification of Nest Edge Layering of Compound Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The key to the failure of the whole structure and the oil leakage of the fuel tank is the delamination of the composite material around the hole of the cover, the moment test was carried out to study the limit load of the composite cap under different conditions. At the same time, the history of fault in-depth analysis and replication verification. The results show that the higher the verticality of the hole, the smaller the ultimate load capacity of the composite material on the edge of the hole, so the verticality of the hole is one of the factors that affect the delamination of the edge of the hole, the mounting moment of the bolt is not allowed to exceed 11 nm for hole verticality within 2°. Based on the application of aeronautical field, this paper studies the tightening moment of composite material mouth cover, and analyzes the failure mode and reason of hole edge delamination, it is of great value in engineering applications for the standardization of the joint installation of composite cover.

articleTitle: Finite Frequency Fault Detection for Discrete Descriptor Systems Based on Event-Triggering Mechanism and Zonotopic Residual Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In this paper, a new event-triggered fault detection (FD) method is proposed for discrete descriptor systems. Firstly, the event-triggering mechanism is designed to reduce the communication burden. Then, the attenuation of the residual against disturbances and the sensitivity of the residual to faults are improved by utilizing H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance and finite frequency H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</inf> performance. The filter gain matrices and event-triggering parameters are obtained by solving the optimization problem. Furthermore, compared with the full frequency FD scheme, the proposed method is able to improve the FD performance. Finally, a simulation example verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Portable, Non-contact, Proximal Sensing of Sands in Soil Using Microwave Radar Array, Fractional Fourier Transform, and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The sand content of the soil is one of the primary factors that influence its texture. To effectively monitor soil quality, a fast and accurate method for measuring soil sand content is crucial. Although remote sensing techniques have shown promise in monitoring soil sand content, their effectiveness is limited by factors such as weather conditions and vegetation. This study proposes a contactless approach that utilizes a portable microwave sensor, along with machine learning algorithms, to measure the soil sand content. With its compact and portable form, the sensor offers flexible deployment in the field and produces accurate data information. In this study, radio reflectance data were collected by the microwave sensor from six levels of soil with varying sand content ratios. The features were extracted by using different data preprocessing methods such as fractional Fourier Transform(FRFT) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Machine learning algorithms, including Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), were applied to classify the data. The results indicate that the proposed approach is effective in measuring soil sand content, with an accuracy rate of up to 81%. In addition, the accuracy of the classification varies between 52.4% and 81%, depending on the specific preprocessing method and machine learning algorithms employed. The highest accuracy was achieved using a Quadratic SVM with data processed by the 0.8th order Fourier transform.

articleTitle: An improved genetic algorithm to solve a customer driven low carbon job scheduling problem in service-oriented manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The traditional job shop scheduling problem usually takes performance indicators, such as the completion time, cost, as the global optimization objectives. However, with the service-oriented manufacturing pattern applied, each custom-er with manufacturing tasks will pay more attention to its own requirements and profits. Meanwhile, in order to respond to the global climate change, the manufacturing further focus on energy conservation and emission reduction. With an eye to the requirements in this new environment, in this paper, a non-cooperative game model for flexible job-shop scheduling with the goal of carbon emissions under constraint of due-date is given. In the model, the player refers to manufacturing tasks submitted by related customers, the strategy of each job refers to the selectable machines related to the operations of the job, and the payoff of each job refers to the makespan and carbon emissions. To get the optimal scheduling results, an improved genetic algorithm is adopted to solve the Nash equilibrium (NE) point of the mod-el. Finally, a case is designed to test the applicability and feasibility of the proposed model and method

articleTitle: Temporal Graph Convolutional Network Soft Sensor for Chemical Process with Distributed Outputs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: To explore data-driven soft sensors and enhance the model explainability, a temporal graph convolutional network is proposed for chemical processes with distributed outputs. It can model process variable relationships in the form of a topology graph. Firstly, the subgraph from prior knowledge is constructed and supplemented using mutual information. In this way, the advantages of both prior knowledge and process data are explored to construct the topology graph. Then, the spatial and temporal dependencies are captured by a graph convolutional layer and a gated recurrent unit, respectively. Finally, a soft sensor based on the spatiotemporal graph convolutional network is established for quality prediction of the chemical process with distributed outputs. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by molecular weight distribution prediction of a styrene radical polymerization process.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Sparse Optimization Algorithm for Gated Recurrent Units Estimators
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Industrial processes are always with sophisticated characteristics in particular highly nonlinear, multivariate coupling, and dynamic time lag. To overcome these dilemmas, a gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural network based on ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> - regularization is proposed to design effective prediction algorithms for the processes. Firstly, a primordial GRU model is trained from the given data. Secondly, a two-stage regularization algorithm is integrated into the fundamental model to simplify the input gate and the hidden layers of the GRU, respectively, which simultaneously achieves input variable selection and structural optimization. Finally, the performance of the proposed double ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>-regularized GRU is verified through a practical industrial dataset and compared with other machine learning algorithms. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can extract relevant features and simplify the model structure, therefore improving the prediction accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Pareto Frontier Optimization of Discontinuous Areas Based on Sewage Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Practical engineering wastewater treatment procedures are susceptible to influence from outside sources and have other features because of their complexity and unpredictability. Its multi-objective optimization problem's pareto frontier may have discontinuity and unsmooth problems, making it difficult for the method to successfully search close to the discontinuity area. This paper proposes an optimization strategy based on subspace evolution, which uses information from the population evolution process to determine the discontinuous region. The target space is divided into multiple subspaces for optimization. At the same time, cross mutation is performed on individuals near the discontinuous region to predict the shape of the pareto frontier one by one in the subspaces. Finally, the various optimized subsets are combined to output the optimized solution set. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested strategy produces better distribution of Pareto borders in the target space and better optimization outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on similarity comparison method of engineering time series data based on improved dynamic pattern matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Traditional time series similarity comparison method is difficult to calculate the similarity of curve shape quantitatively. A new method is proposed in this paper in order to solve this problem. This method consists of two steps: extracting the pattern of time series and measure the similarity of the pattern. Experiments are carried out based on the workflow data of a certain device. The proposed method and traditional method are used to find the time series which has the largest deviation from others. In these experiments, the proposed method can achieve 91.7% accuracy while the accuracy of traditional method is 50% or less. This result shows that the proposed method has better discrimination ability on the shape of the time series curve.

articleTitle: A PID Based on RBF Neural Network for a Material Weighing and Proportioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: A PID controller based on RBFNN is designed for the material weighing and proportioning system. In the controller, the RBFNN is used to establish the system model, and provides the gradient information needed to adjust the PID parameters. In the end, the validation of the design scheme is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of The Schroeder Phased Harmonic Sequence in Testing the Frequency haracteristics of Servo Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This article introduces the basic principle of The Schroeder Phased Harmonic Sequence testing method. The real experiment of multi-harmonic signal testing method is carried out for a servo system, and the accuracy and rapidity of the method are verified. Finally, according to the experimental data, the threshold standard of the excitation parameters of the multi-harmonic confidence signal test method is proposed, which provides the basis for the parameter selection in the frequency characteristic test of the servo system.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimal Self-Learning Tracking Control for Two-Time Scale System
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper devotes to solving the optimal tracking control (OTC) problem of singular perturbation systems in industrial processes under the framework of reinforcement learning technology. The encountered challenges include the different time scales in system operations and an unknown slow process. The immeasurabilty of slow process states especially increases the difficulty of finding the optimal tracking controller. To overcome these challenges, a novel off-policy ridge RL method is developed after decomposing the singular perturbed systems using the singular perturbation (SP) theory and replacing unmeasured states using important mathematical manipulations. Theoretical analysis of approximate equivalence of the sum of solutions of subproblems to the solution of the OTC problem is presented. Finally, a mixed separation thickening process (MSTP) and a numerical example are used to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: A hybrid model of CNN-BiLSTM and XGBoost for HVAC systems energy consumption prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Predicting energy consumption in Heating, Ventilating and Air Conditioning(HVAC) systems is of great significance for optimizing energy consumption, as well as for energy saving and emission reduction in modern buildings. However, using a single energy consumption prediction method has inherent limitations. In this paper, we propose a new hybrid model of CNN-BiLSTM and XGBoost for predicting energy consumption in HVAC systems. The new model extracts time series features of the data through a CNN network, and simultaneously mines forward and backward information using a BiLSTM network. Then, the information extracted by the two networks is integrated to obtain a pre-training model. Finally, the model is optimized by XGBoost to obtain the final prediction result. Comparing the proposed new model with the prediction results of CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM and CNN-BiLSTM models, it can be concluded that the proposed model has higher accuracy and lower error value. Therefore, the hybrid model shows promising potential for predicting energy consumption in HVAC systems.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Control of MIMO Over-actuated Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper presents a control method for a class of first-order MIMO over-actuated nonlinear systems to solve the output tracking problem. Firstly, the virtual control matrix of the system is decomposed into a known bounded matrix with full row rank multiplied by completely unknown matrix. The controller is then yielded by multiplying the known matrix, the barrier function matrix and its partial derivatives matrix. The resulting controller guarantees the prescribed tracking performance and the boundedness of the signals in the closed loop. Finally, a simulation example is presented to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: 3D Numerical Simulation of Grate Type MSWI Process for Furnace Temperature Control Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) process has advantages such as high capacity reduction rate, fast processing speed and in-situ incineration. Under un-stable operational conditions, especially furnace temperature, the emitted pollution such as SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</inf>, HCl and dioxins may exceed national emission standards. In order to obtain the relationship between the control variables and the incinerator temperature, 3D numerical simulation for an actual MSWI process in Beijing is carried out. The structure of the incinerator is described and its 3D CFD model constructed. The, the baseline working condition experiments is made based on the actual process parameters. The influence of primary and secondary air and their ratio to the temperature field are analyzed. These results can provide support for the optimization control of the actual MSWI process.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Tracking Control for Ship Autopilot System With Course Constraint
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper explores the course constrained tracking control problem for the ship autopilot system, in the case where the reference is not known a priori. The absence prior knowledge of the reference results in the classical prescribed performance control subject to course constraints unfeasible. To address this problem, we propose a novel prescribed performance control. A new-type error boundary is introduced in the control design. It is proved that the proposed control guarantees reference tracking with prescribed accuracy and constraint satisfaction simultaneously. The proposed control is free of identification, approximation, estimation, or derivation. Finally, a simulation study illustrate the above theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Oil pipeline operating condition identification based on deep convolution self-coding
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: To solve the problem of difficult identification of pipeline signals under different working conditions, a one-dimensional deep convolution self-coding method for pipeline leakage identification was proposed. One-dimensional deep convolution and adaptive encoder are used to conduct unsupervised learning training for signal features, extract data features, and learn data feature information through the convolution layer and pooling layer. Finally, the results of pipeline working condition discrimination are output. The experimental results show that the method can accurately judge the working conditions of different types of pipelines with an accuracy of 97.37%. The superiority of this method in leakage diagnosis is verified by comparison with other methods.

articleTitle: Task Decomposition and Resource Allocation in Cloud Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper investigates task decomposition and resource allocation in cloud manufacturing environment. Considering the problem of task decomposition, the correlation between the two meta-tasks is obtained by the expert evaluation method, and the task decomposition model is solved by the simulated annealing algorithm. When solving the problem of resource allocation, the master-slave game model is constructed by considering the interests of the cloud platform side, the demand side and the service side. Then, the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-II (NSGA-II) with bi-level programming ideal is adopted to solve the model. Finally, numerical experiments are carried out on both models to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Distributed Hierarchical Control of Battery Energy Storage Cluster for Peak-load Shifting
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In microgrids, renewable energies and time-varying loads usually cause power fluctuations even result in security and stability risks. In this paper, battery energy storage clusters (BESC) are used to provide ancillary services, e.g., smoothing the tie-line power fluctuations and peak-load shifting for microgrids due to their aggregated and controllable power consumptions. A distributed hierarchical control strategy is proposed to regulate the BESC to peak-load shifting. In the first layer, a novel optimization algorithm is designed to regulate the BESC to minimize the fluctuations of tie-line power. In the second layer, a distributed control algorithm is developed for each BESC to allocate the calculated power through the first layer. Finally, several simulation results are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed distributed hierarchical control strategy.

articleTitle: Prediction of FeO Content in Sintering Process Based on Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In view of the difficulty in online measurement of FeO content of sinter and the waste of computing resources caused by the deployment of complex models on edge computing devices, this paper proposes a prediction method of FeO content in the sintering process based on knowledge distillation. Firstly, a teacher network with ResNet-50 structure is pre-trained using large dataset and partial sintering image dataset, and some structures are improved on the basis of the original residual network. The student network with ResNet-18 structure is trained by knowledge distillation method, so that the small model learns the supervision information and good generalization ability of the large model. While preventing over-fitting of the model, the accuracy is improved. It is verified by experiments that the model after knowledge distillation is lighter, saves computing resources, and can accurately predict the FeO content in the sintering process, which has industrial practical value.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-Triggered Distributed Model-Free Adaptive Control for Unknown Nonlinear MASs with Stochastic Cyber-Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper studies the dynamic event-triggered distributed model-free adaptive control problem for unknown nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs), in the presence of stochastic cyber-attacks. Firstly, the distributed output tracking error formula of all agents are transformed into linear model using dynamic linearization method. Then, in order to alleviate the impact of stochastic cyber-attacks on system performance, the compensation mechanism based on predictive distributed output tracking error is proposed. In addition, considering the burden of network communication resources, the dynamic event-triggered mechanism is introduced. Based on the above, a new distributed model-free adaptive control scheme is established to ensure consistent tracking of all agents. Finally, numerical example is given to verify the validity of this control scheme.

articleTitle: Model-Free Prescribed Performance Control of Pendulum Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The tracking control problem for torsional pendulum systems with unknown control directions and unknown disturbances is investigated in this paper. First, a class of orientation functions are introduced to cope with unknown control directions in lieu of the Nussbaum functions. Then, a prescribed performance controller is designed, which is robust to unknown disturbances. Furthermore, the proposed controller can effectively treat the unknown nonlinearities without invoking the tools for approximation, identification, and estimation. Based on dialectic by contradiction, it is proved that all the signals in the controlled systems are bounded and the tracking performance with the predefined convergence rate and accuracy is achieved. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed algorithm is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: GAF-AlexNet based Incipient Agglomerates Monitoring of Fluidized Bed Reactor*
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: For the complex chemical processes, traditional abnormal monitoring methods show low alarm accuracy and poor real-time performance due to the limitation of environmental interference and operational experience. Moreover, the monitored data are mostly time series with the important signal features masked by noise. This study proposes a kind of deep learning-based monitoring method to alarm the incipient agglomeration in a gas-solid fluidization polymer production. The proposed method takes the acoustic signal as the monitoring signal. First the time-frequency analysis is used to extract the fault features hidden in the original acoustic wave and enrich the tiny agglomeration information. Then, the time series in the time-frequency domain are converted into Gramian Angular Field (GAF) images which encode the one-dimension data into 2D pictures by preserving the temporal dependency features. Finally, the improved AlexNet is proposed to monitor the incipient agglomerates. The proposed method is verified in an actual gas-solid fluidized bed equipment, and the experimental results show that it effectively increases the fault detection rate and decreases the false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Networked Multi-Agent Distributed Control Framework for Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenges of massive and dispersed controllable electricity loads and vulnerability to time delay and packet loss for demand response in power systems. To improve the control efficiency of massive and dispersed electricity loads, a novel framework that contains an aggregation layer between the main site and dispersed resources is proposed. This framework enables dispersed electricity loads to follow the global objective in different geographical conditions. However, the increasing number of massive resources can lead to a communication explosion, especially when communication delay and packet loss are considered. To mitigate this issue, a distributed algorithm is introduced to reduce the communication volume, improving the convergence rate. We show that the proposed algorithm achieves consensus. Numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on big-scale systems, showing a faster convergence rate than centralized methods.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning-based Robust Optimization under Disjunctive Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In practical industrial processes, uncertain parameters often affect the feasibility and optimality of production decisions. Robust optimization is a classical method for optimization under uncertainty and focuses on the construction of uncertainty sets. However, it is difficult to capture the uncertainty space with disjunctive structures accurately using a single uncertainty set, which will lead to conservative decisions. Therefore, considering the probability distribution information of data, this paper proposes an unsupervised learning-based data-driven robust optimization method under disjunctive uncertainties. Gaussian mixture model (GMM) is applied to extract the underlying Gaussian distributions of uncertainties. Then, support vector clustering (SVC) is employed to construct a union of data-driven uncertainty sets, which can depict disjunctive uncertainties more accurately. The tractable robust counterpart optimization problem is developed on the basis of derived uncertainty sets. A numerical example and an industrial case are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and the influence of the regularization parameter on the optimization results is discussed.

articleTitle: Novel Two-Stream Deep Fast-Slow Features Extraction for Chemical Process Soft Sensing Application
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Chemical process data are the coexistence of fast-varying and slow-trend, which often exhibit strong nonlinearity and time-varying characteristics due to the complex physical and chemical mechanisms. The single model-based methods cannot show satisfactory performance, because the slow features and fast features are difficult to be extracted. This paper proposes a two-stream fast and slow feature fusing model (TS-FSFM), in which two-stream network structure including a slow feature stream and a fast feature stream is designed to extract slow and fast features in parallel. The slow feature stream is equipped with an encoder-decoder-based Siamese network and a fully connected (FC) layer for slow feature extraction, where long short-term memory (LSTM) networks are employed as the encoder and decoder units. Meanwhile, the fast feature stream consists of the conventional LSTM and FC networks for fast feature extraction. Finally, the features learned from the two streams are fused, and a supervised learning regression layer is employed for process soft sensing. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are demonstrated on an industrial process case.

articleTitle: Clustering Time Series from Complex Systems using Intermittent Forces in System Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Clustering of time series from highly nonlinear systems has got board attentions with the increasing importance of understanding nonlinearity in applications. The recent clustering algorithms build high-quality features using complicated deep learning black-box models, which usually lack interpretability and ill-performance happens often when applying to complex systems. This paper focuses on the problem of clustering chaotic signals that mans can easily distinguish while the state-of-the-art performs poorly. We introduce the HAVOK analysis from physics and smartly use it as an interpretable way to extract essential nonlinear features for clustering. By further incorporating k-Shape algorithm, we present an effective time series clustering technique for signals from complex systems. Numerical examples demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art for clustering of chaotic time series.

articleTitle: Pipeline leakage detection based on MTF-dual channel multiscale CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the subtle feature extraction of one-dimensional(1D) vibration data is not obvious and the real-time detection speed is slow in pipeline leak detection. In this paper, a Markovian transition field(MTF) based pipeline leak detection algorithm with dual-channel multiscale convolutional neural networks(CNN) is proposed. First, the negative pressure wave signal collected by the pressure sensor is converted into a time-correlated two-dimensional(2D) feature image through the MTF encoding method. Then, the feature image is used as the input of a two-channel multi-scale CNN for automatic feature extraction for leak detection. Through comparative experiments, the results show that the average recognition rate of no leakage, 2, 5, and 8 mm leakage holes is 95.37%. Compared with SVM and 1DCNN, the method proposed in this paper has significant improvement and can be applied to pipeline leak detection.

articleTitle: A Multi-target Multi-clustering Trajectory Optimization Strategy for Multi-UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play an important role in providing coverage for communication terminals during disaster relief efforts. This article investigates a path planning algorithm for UAVs that takes into account communication, the number of UAVs, and constraints on their journey. A quantity estimation algorithm (QEA) is proposed to estimate the quantity of UAVs used for communication tasks based on the K-means algorithm. The problem can be abstracted as the traveling salesman problem (TSP) in order to minimize the UAV cruise time as much as possible. Optimal paths are then solved using ant colony optimization (ACO). The planning trajectory obtained using single clustering and ACO cannot meet the operational limitations of UAVs. Therefore, a multi-target multi-clustering optimization algorithm is proposed for UAVs based on the K-means algorithm. In addition, the efficiency of cruising can be improved through multiple effective cluster analyses by utilizing the proposed center path and second cluster path methods. These results indicate that the proposed algorithms can improve the likelihood of successfully achieving multiple targets during UAV cruising.

articleTitle: Continual Learning Assisted Dynamic Modeling for Industrial Multimode Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Conventional dynamic modeling approaches for multimode processes with dynamics can only establish a local model for each mode and have difficulty increasing their prediction range due to distribution discrepancies. When a new mode emerges, the re-trained prediction model inevitably forgets important information from the historical modes, resulting in performance degradation. To address this limitation, we propose a continual learning-based dynamic modeling method called continual echo state network (CESN) for multimode processes. The method uses elastic weight consolidation (EWC) to alleviate catastrophic forgetting of the historical modes. Finally, we present the experimental results of the three-phase flow process to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed CESN method.

articleTitle: The existence of a positive solution for nonlinear fractional differential equations with integral boundary value conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In this paper, the existence of solutions for a class of nonlinear boundary value problems of fractional differential equations with integral boundary conditions is studied. Our method is based on the Guo-Krasnoselskii fixed point theorem, allowing us to extend some previously known results. We carefully study the sign of the related Green’s function and get the exact value that it is positive in its domain. The existence of the solution comes from the definition of a suitable cone on a Banach space. Compared with other "positive solutions of nonlinear fractional differential equations with integral boundary value conditions", my main contribution is to generalize the boundary conditions, make them more general, and construct cones cleverly to prove the existence of positive solutions. The conclusion of this paper is illustrated with examples.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Agent System-Based Tracking Control for Battery Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper presents a coordinated control model for battery energy storage systems. Firstly, the characteristics of energy storage units, control objectives of algorithms, and the hierarchical architecture of energy storage systems are analyzed. Then, corresponding distributed control strategies are proposed for homogeneous battery energy storage systems and discrete battery energy storage systems based on sampled data. The proposed strategies achieve the objectives of power tracking, power sharing, and consensus of state of charge (SoC) of the battery energy storage systems simultaneously.

articleTitle: Quality classification of ultra-narrow gap welding based on GAF-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Ultra-narrow gap welding with flux band-constrained arc is a welding method with high efficiency and low heat input, but its welding process is complex, and it is difficult to realize online prediction of welding quality. The traditional signal feature extraction method can not make full use of time series information. In addition, the use of convolutional neural network training will have the problem of gradient disappearance as the number of network layers increases. Because of the above problems, this paper proposes a welding quality classification prediction method based on GAF-ResNet, carries out ultra-narrow gap welding experiments, and performs model accuracy verification and performance analysis. The one-dimensional time series is encoded into a two-dimensional image by GAF image, which retains the time dependence of the time series. The ResNet network is used to deeply mine the time series information in the image array to ensure the depth of feature extraction. The analysis results show that the experimental results of GASF are better than those of GADF. The accuracy and F1 value of the GAF-ResNet model reached 88.163 % and 88.109 %, respectively. Compared with other modes, the overall performance of the model is better than that of the control group.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Smart Home Energy Management Based on Proximal Policy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The role of smart home energy management systems in optimizing residential energy consumption and promoting efficient energy utilization is of paramount importance. This paper proposes a data-driven smart energy management system utilizing the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) approach. Primarily, the problem is formulated by devising energy management algorithms that encompass a diverse range of devices with distinct functionalities, including photovoltaic (PV) systems and electric vehicles (EVs), within the framework of an intelligent domicile energy management system. The algorithm employs a multitude of hyperparameter combinations during the modeling phase to establish multiple models, subsequently selecting the most optimal hyperparameter combinations by closely scrutinizing characteristic values and their specific performances within the system. Finally, the paper addresses the modeling of optimization challenges pertaining to smart homes and develops a home energy management algorithm based on PPO to minimize electricity costs while simultaneously prioritizing consumer comfort.

articleTitle: A Method based on Feature Reuse and Structure Re-parameterization for Magnetic Flux Leakage Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) testing of pipelines is of great significance to ensure the safe operation of pipelines. However, the traditional depth learning method has some limitations for accurate detection of pipeline defects. On the basis of the existing YOLOV7 neural network structure, this paper proposes a method based on feature reuse and structure re-parameterization (FRSR) for magnetic flux leakage defect detection. First, the feature reuse split-attention (FRS) module is added to the backbone to achieve better speed precision balance. Secondly, a structure re-parameterization deformable convolutional (Repdcn) module is proposed to efficiently fuse features of different levels, construct weights during training, and fuse during reasoning. The experiment proves the effectiveness of the proposed method. The detection accuracy is improved from 83.6% to 88.9%.

articleTitle: Metal hybrid wire electroburst spraying is used for the preparation of 65Mn steel surface coating
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In the coating preparation process, the spray material is a key factor in determining the performance of the coating. Moreover, the coating formed by the monofilament electric explosion has problems such as low wear and corrosion resistance. In order to solve the above problems, this study investigates the effects of energy deposition rate and Fe-Al intermetallic compounds on coating properties under 7.2-10.5kV charging voltage on the continuous wire electroburst spraying experimental platform using Fe-Al metal mixed wire as the spraying material and employs the "concentric double twisting" winding method. The experimental results show that the energy deposition utilization rate of the electric explosion of Fe-Al metal mixing wire is the best when the charging voltage is 8.0-9.6kV, and the Fe-Al intermetallic compounds generated by the explosion enhance the strength and hardness of the coating, and improve the wear resistance and corrosion resistance of the coating.

articleTitle: Existence of Positive Solutions for Coupled Fractional Q-difference Problem with Coupled Integral Boundary Conditions*
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper investigates a coupled fractional q-difference problem with coupled integral boundary conditions. First, we give the Green’s function for the problem and discuss some properties of the Green’s function. By using Fixed point theorem in Banach space and Leray-Schauder alternative, we conclude some existence results of positive solutions for the coupled system when the problem meets certain conditions. At last, examples are presented to illustrate our main results.

articleTitle: Data-driven modeling of manipulator for bilateral teleoperation system using reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Widespread interest has been shown in bilateral teleoperation systems as a way of replacing people in isolated and hazardous locations. The construction of the manipulator dynamics model on master and slave side of bilateral teleoperation systems is one of the keys to attaining the tracking performance of systems. Uncertain errors such as manipulator dynamics parameters make it difficult to build an accurate system dynamics model purely by relying on conventional dynamical mechanism modelling methods. This paper proposes a data-driven approach to build a dynamics model of the manipulator from data such as the joint angle, joint angular velocity and joint torque of the manipulator based on reinforcement learning algorithm, and verifies the accuracy of the built dynamics model through testing.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Optimization System For River Source Heat Pump Units Based On Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The energy consumption of air conditioning systems is an important part of the energy consumption of buildings, and is particularly important today when energy efficiency in buildings is a major worldwide trend and trend. This paper uses river water as the system cooling source for the building cooling to save energy. In this paper, energy consumption models for chillers, heat pump units, pumps and energy storage tanks are first developed. The energy consumption of the pumps is fitted for optimization, using a penalty function to ensure that the optimization parameters are within the constraints. The energy consumption of the heat pump system is then optimized using a two-layer particle swarm algorithm. Finally, the optimization is carried out with a typical day-by-day hourly cooling load. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper not only reduces the energy consumption of the heat pump system and achieves peak shifting and valley filling, but also reduces the operating costs of the air conditioning system, which has good economic benefits.

articleTitle: Intermediate Estimator-based Attack Reconstruction for Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the attack reconstruction problem for cyber-physical systems (CPSs) under false data injection (FDI) attacks, where both of sensor attacks and actuator attacks are taken into consideration. While existing attack estimation methods typically require satisfying observer matching conditions, such conditions are often challenging to meet in many systems. To overcome this limitation, a reconstruction method based on intermediate variables is developed to estimate the attack occurring at sensors and actuators. The developed method has low computational complexity and high scalability. It is proved that the states of the error system are uniformly and finally bounded. Simulation examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Query for Large-scale Manufacturing Product Lifecycle based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The data query for large-scale manufacturing product lifecycle provides the data basis for finding out the processes and causes of the quality problems. At present, lifecycle data query methods are inefficient due to the complex search process. Therefore, this paper designs an efficient data query method for large-scale manufacturing product lifecycle. The new method uses blockchain technology, improves the original transaction structure, and sets K-V(Key-Value) database tables. Firstly, add pre-index and post-index to the transaction data structure. Secondly, store the correspondence between the pre/post-index and the hash value of transactions through K-V database tables. Thirdly, a new efficient lifecycle data query algorithm is designed using the pre&post-index. Finally, a comparative experiment is carried out to validate the efficiency of the efficient lifecycle data query method. The results show that the new method is more efficient than current methods.

articleTitle: Pipeline Location Method Based on Pipeline Current Mapper and Its Hardware Realization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Based on the pipeline current mapper method, this paper designs a sensing system using tunneling magnetoresistance sensors and proposes a scheme that can accurately locate the pipeline in real-time. By detecting the time difference between the magnetic signals of different frequencies around the pipeline and the reference signals, the relative position (left or right) of the pipeline is judged. By measuring the amplitude relationship of magnetic induction intensity in different directions around the pipeline, the horizontal distance and plumb distance between the pipeline and the detection equipment are calculated.

articleTitle: Fusion Ensemble Modeling Method Using Bayesian Inference and Binary Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The traditional ensemble modeling method has problems such as complex calculation, low precision, and insufficient generalization performance. Therefore, this article proposes three modeling methods based on Bayesian inference and binary tree fusion ensembled (BTFE). Among them, Bayesian inference are used as the selection rule and to distinguish the adaptability of sub-model. Three different modeling methods based on Bagging and binary tree are proposed to replace the traditional complex ensemble model, which reduces the training difficulty of the model and improves the interpretability of the ensemble model. The binary tree and Bayesian inference fusion method is proposed to construct the selective ensemble model. Experimental results on benchmark data sets show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Upper Limb Joint Angle Prediction Method Based On Lssvm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In recent years, the incidence of stroke has been increasing. In order to enhance patient engagement and improve rehabilitation outcomes in active training, it is necessary to obtain real-time information about the patient's movement intention. This paper addresses the issues of poor accuracy and slow prediction speed in current models for predicting patient movement intention. A method based on Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) is proposed to predict upper limb joint angles. By continuously estimating the joint angles based on surface electromyographic signals acquired from normal upper limbs, these estimated angles serve as control guidance for the rehabilitation robot of the affected upper limb. In this paper, the patient's movement intention is defined as continuous joint angles. Surface electromyographic signals are obtained as input features, while the patient's joint angles serve as output features. LSSVM is employed as a regression method to predict the trend of joint angle changes, aiming to predict the patient's movement intention.

articleTitle: Simulating Market Concentration and Capital Distribution: Insights into Firm Dynamics and Economic Inequality
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: We use an agent-based model to study firm dynamics, market concentration, capital distribution and the critical role of banking capital in economic markets. Our model incorporates firm profit stochastic fluctuations allowing for firm entries and exits in economic markets. Our results show how shifts in economic parameters influence capital allocation and market concentration. One key result of our study is that under quite general assumptions even when wealth is initially evenly distributed among all participants, as time progresses, a small number of agents accumulate a substantial portion of the total wealth, while a large number of agents have a comparatively small share. This research is a critical tool for policymakers, economists, and researchers, facilitating a deeper comprehension of market structures, wealth distribution, and offering strategic responses to economic system dynamics.

articleTitle: Milling Chatter Monitoring based on Improved Deep Residual Network and Transfer Learning Approach*
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The multi-cavity and thin-wall parts commonly utilized in aerospace have suffered from chatter during cavity milling. This paper proposes an online chatter monitoring method for the cavity milling process based on an improved deep residual network and transfer learning. First, input the time-frequency maps obtained by the short-time Fourier transform approach into the deep residual network, and fuse the trained deep features with artificial chatter features to build the chatter monitoring model for low-speed processes. Then, using the established model and small sample data, a new model suitable for high-speed operations is quickly set up through the parameter transfer learning method. The experimental results demonstrate that the classification accuracy of the above two models is 99.06% and 99.38%, respectively, which is superior to the threshold model based on artificial features and can be applied to the chatter monitoring of cavity milling under complex cutting paths and variable process parameters.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Prescribed Performance Control of Unknown MIMO Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper investigates the fault-tolerant control problem for the multi-input multi-output nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics and process faults. The process faults together with the unknown dynamics lead to dynamic uncertainties in the plant, such that the commonly used approximation techniques fail to be applied straightforward. To overcome this challenge, a novel fault-tolerant prescribed performance control scheme is developed in this paper. Except for the known control direction of the plant, no prior knowledge of the system model and the process faults is involved in the control law. Even so, there is no need to invoke the techniques for function approximation, parameter identification, disturbance estimation, fault detection, fault estimation, fault isolation, etc. The proposed controller guarantees reference tracking with the predefined transient and steady-state performance. The simulation results manifest the effectiveness and the advantage of the controller.

articleTitle: Data management of salt cavern gas storage based on data model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: In response to the lack of comprehensive unified management of data in the early stage of information construction in the salt cavern gas storage industry, which leads to the emergence of data silos, redundancy, and quality problems, increases the risk of data security, restricts the use of data value, and increases the difficulty of data governance for salt cavern gas storage reservoirs, there is still a certain gap with the realization of digital gas storage, this paper proposes a data governance solution based on data modeling for the salt cavern gas storage industry. The proposed solution gradually establishes a data model from the current situation of the salt cavern gas storage industry, forming a layered architecture of the data model for salt cavern gas storage. Through the implementation of this solution, the quality and accuracy of the salt cavern gas storage data can be effectively improved, and the application value and decision-making support capabilities of the data can be enhanced.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheme for Landing Fuel of Mars Probe
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper discusses a control scheme aimed at minimizing fuel consumption during the landing process of the Tianwen-1 Mars probe. To achieve this goal, a genetic algorithm is employed to optimize the control parameters, including thrust-to-weight ratio and thrust angle. Through iterative optimization, we obtained a solution that minimizes fuel consumption while ensuring a safe landing of the probe. The research results of this paper are of great significance for future Mars exploration missions, as they can improve the safety and efficiency of landings, while also providing a reference for other similar space missions.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling and Sensitivity Analysis of Solid Phase Combustion in MSWI Process Based on Benchmark Operational Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) process is complex physical and chemical reactions with strong coupling and nonlinear characteristics. In addition to the main operating factors such as combustion airflow and waste feeding speed, the combustion status of solid waste is also affected by many other parameters, such as composition, micro, and reaction. In this article, the numerical modeling and sensitivity analysis of solid phase combustion in the grate based on benchmark operational condition is carried out for a MSWI power plant in Beijing. First, the mechanism of solid phase combustion in the grate of a MSWI process is analyzed. Then, the benchmark condition of the incineration plant is determined, that is, the values of common operating variables (feeding, primary airflow, secondary airflow, and grate speed) used in the actual MSWI plant. Finally, the influence of parameters on the MSWI process is analyzed based on the benchmark condition.

Author Keywords: solid phase combustion in the grate

articleTitle: Robust Optimization based Air Combat Game Decision-making of Multi-UAV with Uncertain Information
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: The objective of this study is to design a game decision-making method for the air combat of multiple unmanned air vehicles (multi-UAV) with uncertain information, which is based on flexible and robust optimization. Aiming at the problem that the Nash equilibrium of the UAVs air combat game under uncertain information is not easy to solve, this paper proposes a new method for solving the Nash equilibrium of the air combat game under uncertain information. First of all, the interval payoff matrices of both sides are obtained according to the air combat superiority evaluation method. Secondly, the theory of obtaining the Nash equilibrium of a game by solving a linear programming problem is reviewed. Based on this idea, a novel method is proposed for solving the air combat game problem of multi-UAV with uncertain information, which is achieved by transforming it into a linear programming problem with uncertain parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation, which shows that our method can provide new tools for solving problems in air combat with Uncertain Information.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Control of Multi-Input Multi-Output Nonlinear Systems With Input Quantization
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: This paper explores the problem of tracking control with prescribed performance for a class of uncertain multi-input multi-output nonlinear systems with input quantization. A prescribed performance controller is designed to solve the problem. The convergence rate and the tracking accuracy are predefined by performance functions, and the constraints of the tracking errors are guaranteed by barrier Lyapunov functions. A simple input quantizer is designed to quantize the control inputs. The proposed control strategy ensures that all the tracking errors meet the prescribed performance requirements and all the closed- loop signals are bounded. The simulation results are given to illustrate the established theoretical findings.

articleTitle: A Distributed Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Strategy for Grid Power Peak Shaving and Valley Filling
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Industrial Artificial Intelligence (IAI)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are gaining increasing popularity worldwide due to their significant benefits in energy conservation and emissions reduction. In this paper, we present a novel algorithm to achieve peak shaving and valley filling in the power grid through the utilization of EV charging and discharging, within the framework of demand response.
